name: GPSnoopy/RayTracingInVulkan
description: Implementation of Peter Shirley's Ray Tracing in One Weekend using Vulkan VK_KHR_ray_tracing_pipeline, achieving ~140fps at 1280x720 on an RTX 2080 Ti. Practical reference for RTX hardware ray tracing.
score_rationale: 1.5k-star implementation bridging the popular RTIOW book with real Vulkan RTX hardware, actively updated through 2025.
summary: Vulkan RTX implementation of 'Ray Tracing in One Weekend' achieving ~140fps on RTX 2080.
